# QA Plan: Sprint 1 (Calibration + bootstrap)
**Date**: 2026-10-26 (sprint start; generated 2026-10-25)
**Generated by**: /qa-plan sprint (unattended, autonomous mode, `qa.level: full`, `workflow: full`)
**Scope**: 46 stories across 6 systems (TDC 28, SCL 4, IVP 4, IIF 5, ST 4, CAM 1); 42 schedulable (14 Must, 14 Should, 14 Stretch), 4 blocked. No story file was missing.
**Engine**: Unreal Engine 5.8 (installed 5.8.4)
**Sprint File**: `production/sprints/sprint-01.md` (status source: `production/sprint-status.yaml`)

> Plan basis. Story **Type** fields are accepted as declared (none were missing). Test names, test file paths and
> per-story QA Test Cases below come from each story's own `## Acceptance Criteria`, `## QA Test Cases` and
> `## Test Evidence` sections. Where a story's QA Test Cases are the authoritative case list this plan points at them
> and does not restate or add cases ("do not invent test cases"). No story file was edited: the story files already
> carry a `## QA Test Cases` section, so the optional back-fill was declined (decision logged).
> Bootstrap and spike stories have no GDD (TDC) or have a GDD with no AC for the spike itself (SCL-045, IVP spikes), so
> they are plan-derived; those are flagged per story rather than invented.

## Automated Tests Required

*(`qa.level: full`: per-story tests plus per-system coverage targets below.)*

Common rules for every test in this sprint (ADR-0008, `.claude/rules/test-standards.md`, control manifest):
- Names `StealthGame.<System>.<Scenario>`; T1 tests live in the owning module's `Private/Tests/<System>/`; flags `EditorContext | ProductFilter` only until ADR-0008 Verification (7) confirms `WITH_DEV_AUTOMATION_TESTS` in cooked Development builds.
- No wall-clock time as a pass predicate (failure ceiling only), no wall-clock waits, no unseeded randomness, no shared mutable state; once TDC-008 lands, every T1 test asserts zero unexpected faults at teardown.
- Never compile test seams or negative-control types into Shipping; never disable, skip or reseed a failing test; no gate counts as Done unless it was watched to fail (negative control or seeded violation).
- Assets are loaded read-only; the never-resave list (`production/never-resave-assets.md`) is never touched by a test.

### Bootstrap and harness (TDC), Logic stories

#### TDC-007 IStealthClock and fake clock: Logic
**Test file path**: `Source/StealthFoundation/Private/Tests/Harness/FakeClockTest.cpp` (`StealthGame.Harness.FakeClockAdvancesOnlyWhenTold`)
**What to test**:
- Reads of `GetServerTimeSeconds` and `GetServerTickIndex` are identical until the fake is advanced, even after other work lets real time pass (no sleep).
- After an explicit advance both change by exactly the advanced amount; the tick/time relation is explicit in the fake's API (no invented tick length).
**Edge cases to cover**: two fake instances are independent (no statics); the fake compiles to nothing without `WITH_STEALTH_TEST_SEAMS`, so TDC-008's define must land first or with it (undeclared sequencing in the story).
**Estimated test count**: 1 test, 3 to 4 assertions.
*No GDD (bootstrap); cases from the story's QA Test Cases, AC-1.*

#### TDC-008 Fault sink and test-seams define: Logic
**Test file path**: `Source/StealthFoundation/Private/Tests/Harness/FaultSinkTest.cpp` (`StealthGame.Harness.FaultSinkTeardownAssertion`)
**What to test**: a recorded fault fails the teardown assertion; a clean run passes; `WITH_STEALTH_TEST_SEAMS` is defined in Development/editor builds (see Smoke scope for the Shipping side, covered by TDC-006).
**Edge cases to cover**: multiple faults, fault recorded after the test body; define absent in Shipping.
**Estimated test count**: ~2 to 3. *Cases per the story's QA Test Cases.*

#### TDC-009 Log-capture hook: Logic
**Test file path**: `Source/StealthFoundation/Private/Tests/Harness/LogCaptureTest.cpp` (`StealthGame.Harness.LogCaptureAssertsWarningByKey`)
**What to test**: a warning emitted with a key is captured and asserted by key; a different key or absent warning fails the assertion; capture is released at teardown.
**Edge cases to cover**: two keys in one run, key emitted before capture start (must not count), zero captures.
**Estimated test count**: ~3.

#### TDC-010 Negative-control helper: Logic
**Test file path**: `Source/StealthFoundation/Private/Tests/Harness/NegativeControlTest.cpp` (`StealthGame.Harness.NegativeControlDetected`)
**What to test**: the helper passes only when the inner check fails; an inner check that passes makes the helper fail (the helper is itself watched to fail).
**Edge cases to cover**: inner check never runs (must fail, not pass).
**Estimated test count**: ~2 to 3.

#### TDC-011 T0 lint framework and gate: Logic
**Test file path**: selftest under `tools/ci/lint/selftest/` (run by the T0 gate) and `Source/StealthFoundation/Private/Tests/Build/LintFrameworkTest.cpp` (`StealthGame.Build.LintFramework`)
**What to test**: emitter prints one `file:line rule message` observation per finding; gate exits 0 with no findings, nonzero with any, and **NOT ASSESSED (nonzero) when no input files were scanned**; two-file fixture proves each outcome.
**Edge cases to cover**: empty input set, one finding in one of two files, pass/fail decided only by the gate script (the emitter never judges).
**Estimated test count**: 3 selftest cases + 1 wrapper.

#### TDC-012 to TDC-016 Include lint rules and seeded controls: Logic
**Test file paths**: selftests under `tools/ci/lint/selftest/`; wrappers `StealthGame.Build.IncludeLintAbc` (012), `.IncludeLintDef` (013), `.IncludeLintGh` (014), `.IncludeLintIj` (015), `.LintSeededControls` via `seeded-controls.sh` (016), all in `Source/StealthFoundation/Private/Tests/Build/`.
**What to test** (headline per rule set): (a)-(c) header placement, guard header first, a view/presentation file must not include a server header; (d)-(f) core/features include direction, foundation upward includes, unique header names; (g)-(h) server UCLASS specifiers and presentation forbidden APIs; (i)-(j) log arguments and generator random isolation. Each rule passes on the real tree **and fails on a seeded violation**; TDC-016 proves every rule has a seeded violation watched to fail.
**Edge cases to cover**: one clean-tree pass and one seeded fail per rule (negative control mandatory); a rule that scans zero files reports NOT ASSESSED, not pass (TDC-011 behaviour).
**Estimated test count**: ~2 per rule x 10 rules = ~20 selftest cases, 5 wrappers.

#### TDC-018 Replication-system assertion and result JSON: Logic
**Test file path**: `Source/StealthTestHarness/Private/Tests/ReplicationSystemAssertedTest.cpp` (`StealthGame.Harness.ReplicationSystemAsserted`)
**What to test**: harness asserts which replication system is active (legacy driver in MVP) and writes a result JSON; wrong system makes the assertion fail.
**Edge cases to cover**: JSON written on failure as well as pass; depends on TDC-004, 007 and (undeclared) 008.
**Estimated test count**: ~2 to 3.

#### TDC-025 to TDC-028 Hook framework and checks (Stretch): Logic
**Test file paths**: selftests under `tools/ci/hooks/selftest/` (temp-repo based); wrappers `StealthGame.Build.PreCommitHook`, `.NeverResaveCheck`, `.LfsLockCheck`, `.CommitMsgCheck` in `Source/StealthFoundation/Private/Tests/Build/`.
**What to test**: the framework runs the T0 lint; the never-resave check rejects a change to a listed asset and accepts others; the LFS check compares changed assets with `git lfs locks`; the commit-msg hook accepts Conventional Commits with a story or ADR reference and rejects others.
**Edge cases to cover**: temp repos only (never the real repo or remote, except the single recorded real-remote observation for TDC-027); a hook that runs on zero files is NOT ASSESSED.
**Estimated test count**: ~3 per story, ~12 selftest cases.

### Shared Character & Locomotion (SCL), Logic stories

#### SCL-001 One shared pawn class with identical default subobjects: Logic
**Test file path**: `Source/StealthGameplay/Private/Tests/Locomotion/PawnClassDefaultsTest.cpp` (`StealthGame.Locomotion.PawnClassDefaults`)
**What to test** (GDD R1, R3; ADR-0010 section 2):
- `AStealthPawn` derives `ACharacter` with `UStealthMovementComponent`; non-replicated `UGameplayTasksComponent`; `UStealthMotionWarpingComponent` with `WarpTargets` absent from the replicated set (COND_Never).
- `bUseControllerRotationYaw = false`, `bOrientRotationToMovement = true`, `bUseRVOAvoidance = false`, `AutoPossessAI = Disabled`, `AutoPossessPlayer = Disabled`, `SpawnDefaultController` does nothing.
- Two instances (one with a PlayerController stand-in, one with `AStealthCrowdController`) have the same ordered (class, name, replicates) list; AI possession adds no component.
- `Restart()` leaves Velocity (140,0,0) and `MOVE_Walking` unchanged and does not consume the pending input vector.
**Edge cases to cover**: `ReceiveRestarted` still fires via `DispatchRestart`; the reparented `CBP_SandboxCharacter` is checked in a separate Content step with no resave; a `Super::Restart` source scan is secondary.
**Estimated test count**: ~4 to 5 (class shape, default flags, subobject parity, AI possession adds nothing, Restart).
*GDD cases: R1 and R3 are rules, not formulas; no formula to verify. Control manifest: never branch on controller kind (ADR-0001), guarded by SCL-004.*

#### SCL-004 Class parity scan: Logic
**Test file path**: `Source/StealthGameplay/Private/Tests/Locomotion/ClassParityTest.cpp` (`StealthGame.Locomotion.ClassParity`)
**What to test** (AC-SCL-01, GDD R1):
- Static scan plus reflection dump over: pawn C++ and Blueprint class (including `CBP_SandboxCharacter.CanSprint`), `UStealthMovementComponent`, `UStealthAnimInstance`, the AnimBP, step-clock and footstep code. Forbidden-symbol fixture = ADR-0013 section 1 plus `IsBotControlled`, committed as a fixture, with the R9 owner-local allowlist (first-person head hide only).
- Zero forbidden hits outside the allowlist.
- **Mandatory negative control**: the same scan on `_snapshots/2026-10-24_sample-blueprints-pre-resave/` must report at least one hit (`SandboxCharacter.IsLocallyControlled` in `ABP_SandboxCharacter`; `CanSprint` in `CBP_SandboxCharacter`); a pass on the sample means the scan is broken and the story fails.
**Edge cases to cover**: an asset the walker cannot open is NOT ASSESSED and fails; assets load read-only; **the "every SCL tuning key has exactly one value" clause needs SCL-003 (not in sprint): the test must record it as NOT ASSESSED/carryover, never as passing vacuously**, and the story's completion notes state it (matches the sprint DoD).
**Estimated test count**: ~3 (clean scan, allowlist, negative control) plus 1 fixture-integrity check.

#### SCL-005 Remove the AnimBP IsLocallyControlled branch: Logic (+ Visual)
**Test file path**: `Source/StealthGameplay/Private/Tests/Locomotion/` (named test `StealthGame.Locomotion.AnimBpNoLocalControlRead`; file name per the story's Files list)
**What to test** (ADR-0013 section 1): the SCL-004 scan with the derived AnimBP as root reports zero reads of `IsLocallyControlled`, `IsPlayerControlled`, `GetController`, `PlayerState` or any local-control flag in the AnimBP graph, linked layers and `UStealthAnimInstance` (owner-local head hide excepted); AC-SCL-01 scan half passes after the removal; the same scan on the unmodified sample AnimBP still fails (negative control).
**Edge cases to cover**: "any local-control flag" bounded by the fixture of flags from spikes S1/S2; `CanSprint` is covered by SCL-004's roots, not here; the sample assets are never edited in place (duplicate or reparent with a `_snapshots/` copy first; record a blocker rather than resave a never-resave asset).
**Estimated test count**: ~3 (zero reads, linked layers, negative control).

### Integration tests and spikes

#### TDC-001, 002, 004: build-layout tests (Integration)
Named tests as listed in the Test Summary. TDC-001 and TDC-002 are already Complete with passing tests and retained evidence; this plan only requires they stay green on every later run (they are regression gates for TDC-003). TDC-004 asserts statically: `StealthGame.uproject` StealthTestHarness entry `TargetConfigurationDenyList` is exactly Shipping and Test; no `Source/*.Target.cs` lists it in `ExtraModuleNames`; no runtime module's Build.cs names `StealthTestHarness` or `StealthGameEditor`; a Development editor load lists it as loaded.
**Estimated test count**: TDC-001 1 test, TDC-002 1 test, TDC-004 2 tests.

#### TDC-003 Split prototype module (Integration, regression)
No new test file. Required: editor target builds after `StealthGame` depends privately on Foundation, Gameplay and Presentation (keeps `IMPLEMENT_PRIMARY_GAME_MODULE`) and `StealthGameEditor` depends privately on all runtime modules; the 12 prototype tests (6 `StealthGame.Rules.*`, 6 `StealthGame.EditorTools.*`) still pass unchanged; test sources have a clean `git diff --stat`; Blueprint references survive (CoreRedirects). Record the 12 pass lines in the completion note. Hazard: CoreRedirects and never-resave assets; no `Content/*.uasset` is resaved.
**Estimated test count**: 12 existing.

#### TDC-005, 006, 021, 023 CI/tooling Integration stories
Per-commit parts run as selftests plus G2 wrappers (canned inputs): compile probes prove the guard `#error` fires with a positive control; shipping-symbol check finds no harness module or test-seam symbols (selftest on canned inputs); gate script runs T0 lint, build and prefix-filtered automation, under 10 minutes or measured; nightly dry-run. The real UBT `-SingleFile`, packaged Shipping scan, and nightly runner are DEFERRED and must be recorded as observations, not claimed as run.
**Estimated test count**: ~2 selftest cases plus one wrapper each.

#### TDC-019 CQTest listen server with 3 clients headless (Integration)
**Test file path**: `Source/StealthTestHarness/Private/Tests/PIE/ListenServerThreeClientsTest.cpp` (`StealthGame.Harness.PIE.ListenServerThreeClients`, `NETWORK_TEST_CLASS(ListenServerThreeClients, "StealthGame.Harness.PIE")`)
**What to test**: `FPIENetworkComponent` `AsListenServer().WithClients(3).WithGameMode(AStealthGameMode::StaticClass())` on a fixture map completes under `UnrealEditor-Cmd -nullrhi` with one server world and three client worlds, steps bounded by frames/server time.
**Edge cases to cover**: `GetFirstActiveViewport` null headless is the open [U]; the story closes PASS **or** FAIL plus a written ADR-0008 amendment request (fallback T2 in a non-headless editor), never by skipping or disabling; outcome written into the story. Schedule by day 3 (SCL chain waits on it).
**Estimated test count**: 1 CQTest.

#### Spikes (IVP-001, 004, 005, 006; SCL-045; IIF-008; ST-002, 003, 004; ST-001 hook)
Each spike closes on its report (paths in the Test Summary). Required report contents are taken from the story AC and are the check list in the Manual QA section. Spike results have no pass threshold unless the AC says so; "FAIL" is a valid recorded outcome only with its fallback or an amendment request.
ST-001 is a harness hook with a real automated test (`StealthGame.Session.PIE.ConnectionEventHook`, CQTest PIE network, `NETWORK_TEST_CLASS(ConnectionEventHook, "StealthGame.Session.PIE")`) that forces client disconnect, rejoin, supersede and host kick.
ST-003 and ST-004 have named Gauntlet nodes (`StealthGame.Session.MP.SeamlessPersistence`, `.RejoinAdoption`), but T3 multi-process nodes are deferred to a cooked Development build; the documented-playtest alternative is accepted by the story.

### Spike stories: documented-measurement checklists
**Verification method**: written report reviewed by the named owner; never closed by skipping.
**Who must sign off**: qa-lead plus the spike's ADR owner (technical-director for ADR amendments)

IVP-001 (S1), report `production/qa/spikes/<date>_S1-multiprocess.md`:
- [ ] Setup stated: Development build, 1 listen-server and at least 3 client processes, profile StealthLeak2, 2 player and 2 NPC pawns in view of a third client.
- [ ] Capture covers spawn, takeover and AI hand-over (non-owner received bunches and server per-connection changelists).
- [ ] PlayerState, Controller and Owner appear in 0 non-owner changelists for either pawn kind.
- [ ] Negative control (APawn::PlayerState at COND_None) is detected by the same capture.
- [ ] Winning capture mechanism recorded as an ADR-0008 amendment; run length and lifetime counts recorded; RemoteViewPitch16 and CharacterInputState re-measured (recorded only, no threshold).
- [ ] Machine was exclusive for the 2-day timebox; no build ran concurrently.

IVP-004 (S9): [ ] every non-ally connection loses the pawn at the first grid boundary after the deadline, including several pawns in one server frame and a pawn standing on a culled pawn (L27); [ ] the channel stays closed; [ ] under StealthLeak1 and StealthLeak2 with at least 3 clients; [ ] capture artefacts attached (full wording in the story AC).

IVP-005 (S10): [ ] new client actor created each re-open; [ ] NetGUID reuse recorded; [ ] AnimBP initialises from replicated ActionPose and death fast-forwards from DeathServerTime with no visible pop (**retained, lead-signed frame sequence in `production/qa/evidence/`**); [ ] cull followed by un-cull before the client acknowledges the close is covered.

IVP-006 (S12): [ ] cull delay and un-cull lead recomputed from measured L99, numbers in the report.

SCL-045: [ ] (1) starvation forced-update cadence in Hz (ST1); [ ] (2) traversal end-position error distribution, n >= 100 per kind (vault, climb) against the 64 cm bound at PktLag 100 / PktLoss 1 %; [ ] (3) binary E12 decision (`RepRootMotion` vs follow replicated movement); [ ] (4) sample's movement-mode name during traversal; [ ] (5) final heights (vault 0.8 m, climb 1.6 m, optional 1.2 m hurdle); [ ] whether `PktLag` applies to one direction or both. The spike itself has no pass or fail.

IIF-008 (V1): [ ] Enhanced Input edge behaviour reported on this project's contexts (report or probe test).

ST-002: [ ] RTT, packet rate, burst outages and map load time measured and reported. ST-003: [ ] stores and views survive two seamless travels in multi-process standalone (fake Roster allowed). ST-004: [ ] retained PlayerState adopted on rejoin with no visible change to other clients (documented playtest alternative allowed).

Blocked spikes (not tested this sprint; preconditions recorded so the later sprint can plan): IIF-009 needs factory, controller and possession path; IIF-010 needs the IVP cull mechanism; IIF-011 needs a HUD menu root and `UCommonGameViewportClient` configuration; CAM-011 needs the 60-character graybox street and requires retained screenshots.

*Subjective language: none of the in-sprint criteria use "feels/looks"; SCL-005's screenshot is compared to a concrete benchmark (identical animation state on owner and crowd pawn, the same scan result), not a judgement.*

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before any QA hand-off for this sprint (run `/smoke-check sprint`; the first step is the automation run):

1. Editor target builds and the game launches (`tools/dev/cycle.ps1`; `GameDefaultMap=/Game/StealthGame/Maps/L_Prototype`) without crash.
2. A new PIE session starts (listen server plus at least one client) on `L_Prototype`.
3. All existing prototype tests still pass (12), plus every `StealthGame.Build.*` and `StealthGame.Harness.*` test added this sprint (module layout, guard define, harness exclusions, lint wrappers).
4. Regression risk from TDC-003 (module split): Blueprint references resolve, no `Content/*.uasset` modified, `StealthTestHarness` absent from Shipping/Test targets.
5. Primary mechanic changed this sprint: shared-pawn identity parity. `StealthGame.Locomotion.PawnClassDefaults`, `.ClassParity` (with its negative control failing on the sample snapshot) and `.AnimBpNoLocalControlRead` pass; owner pawn and crowd pawn animate identically in PIE (SCL-005 screenshot).
6. T0 gate (`tools/ci/lint/`) passes on the tree and fails on each seeded violation.
7. Save/load: no save system exists yet; not applicable.
8. Performance: no budget test is in scope. All captures are labelled development evidence (no 3060-class reference machine; budgets stay ASSUMED).

*Smoke checks are run by the developer via `/smoke-check sprint`; the config check default for `/smoke-check` is BLOCKING.*

## Definition of Done: This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true (`qa.level: full`):

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified: via automated test result OR documented manual evidence (screenshot, report or playtest notes with sign-off)
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories that name one (qa.level full)
- [ ] Retained screenshot in `production/qa/evidence/` for SCL-005 (player-observable animation); retained, lead-signed frame sequence for IVP-005
- [ ] Signed-off evidence doc at `production/qa/evidence/[story-slug]-evidence.md` for any Visual/Feel evidence (SCL-005)
- [ ] Every spike story has its report in `production/qa/spikes/` with PASS, FAIL plus fallback, or an amendment request
- [ ] Negative control recorded for SCL-004 and SCL-005; seeded violation recorded for each lint rule
- [ ] Smoke check passes (`/smoke-check sprint` before QA hand-off)
- [ ] No regressions (the 12 prototype tests and all earlier `StealthGame.Build.*` tests stay green)
- [ ] Code reviewed (via `/code-review` or documented peer review)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
- [ ] Sprint-level items from the sprint plan: calibration file `production/sprints/sprint-01-calibration.md`, QA sign-off (`/team-qa sprint`), no S1 or S2 bugs

Only Must Have (14) is a commitment; Should, Stretch and Blocked stories need the evidence above only if and when they are pulled in or started.
